svg.title: D-FINE Figure 2 + AQS-L2
svg.desc: Adaptation of D-FINE paper Figure 2. Original decoder heads, residual refined distributions, weighting function and example boxes are retained. AQS is added to the query path after layer 2, not to the FDR distribution path. Enlarged inset adds the classification-score gate input.

g.text: D-FINE with AQS-L2 and Fine-grained Distribution Refinement
Adapted from the original paper Fig. 2: FDR retained; AQS added after Decoder Layer 2.
Original L2 FDR is computed before AQS; distribution refinement is not routed through AQS.
Orange: added AQS. Original FDR / GO-LSD, losses and query count are unchanged.
Original illustrations are retained for architecture explanation, not SCB-S predictions or evidence of an AQS gain.
